\[
S=1+2+\cdots+2015=\frac{2015\cdot 2016}{2}=2015\cdot 1008.
\]
Since \(2015\cdot 1008 = 2016\cdot 1008 - 1008\), we have
\[
S \equiv -1008 \equiv 1008 \pmod{2016}.
\]
We need \(S-x\equiv 0 \pmod{2016}\), so
\[
x\equiv S\equiv 1008 \pmod{2016}.
\]
Since \(1\le x\le 2015\), the only possible value is

\[
\boxed{1008}.
\]
